        Novel Beacons School is a private, faith-based educational institution located in the Ajah axis of Lagos, Nigeria. Operating under the motto "The Place to Shine," the school provides comprehensive day and boarding options spanning Pre-School, Junior School, and Senior School segments.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Chemistry & General Studies Teacher

Job Location: Ajah, Lagos

Requirements

	Preferably a graduate of Chemistry or a related field, with sound knowledge of Mathematics, English and the Sciences, and the ability to teach Upper Primary pupils.


Benefits


	Salary: N85,000 - N100,000 monthly.
	Accommodation is available.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

 

2.) Physical Sciences & Technical Education Teacher

Job Location: Ajah, Lagos

Requirements


	A graduate capable of teaching Physics, Mathematics, Technical Drawing, and Design & Technology.


Benefits


	Salary: N85,000 - N100,000 monthly.
	Accommodation is available.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

3.) Biological Sciences Teacher

Job Location: Ajah, Lagos

	A graduate of Biology or a related field who can teach Biology, Agricultural Science, Home Economics, PHE and other related subjects.

	Salary: N85,000 - N100,000 monthly.

  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "HR Officer",
  "description": "Inguest Global Partners Limited - We lead a Business Solutions and Service Advisory Group, assisting clients in designing and deploying appropriate Organizational Growth and Innovation Solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: HR Officer

Job Location: Yaba, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented HR Officer to support the effective delivery of HR operations and consulting services.
	The role will involve employee management, recruitment, HR documentation, client support, and coordination of HR projects and initiatives.
